title: The Ozone Hole and the Treaty That Worked

segments.say: High above us, a thin layer of ozone blocks the Sun's harmful ultraviolet light. Without it, skin cancer and crop damage would soar.

anim.title: What went wrong
items: One chlorine atom destroys many ozone molecules

segments.say: Chemicals called CFCs, from fridges, sprays and air-conditioners, drifted up. Sunlight broke them, freeing chlorine, and each chlorine atom destroyed ozone over and over.
In nineteen eighty-five, scientists reported a deep thinning over Antarctica every southern spring: the ozone hole.
Countries acted fast. The Montreal Protocol of nineteen eighty-seven phased out CFCs. It became the first treaty signed by every country in the UN.
There was a twist. The replacements, HFCs, spare the ozone but trap heat. So in twenty sixteen, the Kigali Amendment began cutting them too.

anim.title: Healing
items: CFCs in the air are falling
Antarctic ozone back to 1980 levels: about 2066

segments.say: And it's working. Scientists expect the Antarctic ozone layer to recover to its nineteen eighty level around twenty sixty-six.

anim.title: For your answer
items: Proof that global treaties can work

segments.say: For Prelims: Vienna, Montreal, Kigali. And for your essays: proof that the world can fix a global problem together.

sources: UNEP Ozone Secretariat (ozone.unep.org): Vienna Convention 1985; Montreal Protocol 1987; universal ratification (first UN treaties to achieve it, 2009); Kigali Amendment 2016 to phase down HFCs
WMO/UNEP Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2022 (released January 2023): ozone layer on track to recover to 1980 values around 2066 over Antarctica
NASA Ozone Watch / Goddard: ozone layer in the stratosphere; CFCs release chlorine; picture of the Antarctic ozone hole
Farman, Gardiner and Shanklin, Nature, 1985: first report of large springtime ozone losses over Antarctica

quiz.why: HFCs spare ozone but warm the planet.

reviewNote: Facts were read against the UNEP Ozone Secretariat, the WMO/UNEP 2022 assessment and NASA Ozone Watch. The NASA picture shows Antarctica only, no national borders. Moving facts: recovery dates are projections.
